clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong tends to Darkshore's sickened wildlife. She works with travelers to ease the afflictions spreading through the region, especially among its deer.

Alanndarian Nightsong watches over Darkshore's wildlife from the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Taints in the soil and water have left creatures of the ancient woods sick and strangely aggressive. She seeks ways to ease their suffering and restore their strength.

Alanndarian searches for what is making Darkshore's animals ill. She gathers plants and studies the region's water sources, then prepares salves and healing draughts. Travelers help her apply these cures to ailing creatures, in hopes of stopping the corruption from overtaking the wildlife.
